settings.question: How long does Zayro last on skin and clothes?
settings.answer: Zayro is formulated as an Eau de Parfum (EDP) with 15-20% perfume oil concentration. On moisturized skin, it lasts 6 to 8 hours. On clothing and outerwear, its rich amber and agarwood base notes can linger throughout the day.

settings.question: What is the difference between the single and combo packs?
settings.answer: The fragrance formulation in all 3 editions is identical (Zayro 50ml). The 2-in-1 Duo combo and 3-in-1 Grand Trio include complimentary luxury presentation gift boxes.

settings.question: What are the shipping times and is delivery free?
settings.answer: Yes, shipping is 100% complimentary across all pin codes in India for all orders. Metro cities (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune) typically receive delivery in 2-3 business days. All other locations take 3-5 business days with live tracking provided via SMS and email notifications.

settings.question: What is your damaged replacement guarantee?
settings.answer: Every bottle is packaged inside thick shock-resistant transit cushions. In the rare event of transit damage or leakage, simply share a quick photo with our team within 48 hours and we will dispatch a brand-new replacement bottle immediately with zero hassle.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) supported?
settings.answer: Yes! We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and all major credit/debit cards during checkout.

settings.hero_desc: Introducing SAMAY — A magnetic union of sun-drenched citrus, velvety ambergris, and sacred midnight oud. Crafted to captivate senses and linger for 6-8 hours.
settings.philosophy_quote: "In a world where everything moves too fast, true luxury is a fragrance that makes time stand still."

settings.notes_subtitle: Zayro is crafted as an evolving three-act composition that transforms seamlessly with your skin chemistry over 6-8 hours.
settings.showcase_desc: We craft with intention and care. Zayro is formulated with a balanced blend of bergamot, crisp lavender, amber crystals, cedarwood, and rich oud.
settings.about_p1: In Sanskrit and Hindi, Samay means Time. Our perfumery was born from a singular obsession: creating fragrances that refuse to be forgotten. While fashion changes every season, memories ignited by scent echo forever.
settings.about_p2: Every bottle of Zayro is meticulously crafted in small batches in India, marrying traditional distillation of fragrant resins and agarwood with time-honored artisanal techniques. We do not mass produce; each flacon is macerated in dark temperature-controlled cellars for over 60 days to ensure a rich, intoxicating trail.
